econ-io-01-c2.text: U.S. Department of Justice and Federal Trade Commission (2010). Horizontal Merger Guidelines. U.S. Department of Justice.
econ-io-01-c2.quote: Moderately Concentrated Markets: HHI between 1500 and 2500
econ-io-01-c2.claim: The US 2010 Horizontal Merger Guidelines set these bands: – HHI < 1500: unconcentrated – 1500-2500: moderately concentrated – > 2500: highly concentrated

econ-io-01-c2.text: U.S. Department of Justice and Federal Trade Commission (2023). Merger Guidelines. U.S. Department of Justice.
econ-io-01-c2.quote: Markets with an HHI greater than 1,800 are highly concentrated, and a change of more than 100 points is a significant increase.
econ-io-01-c2.claim: The 2023 Merger Guidelines tightened this: above 1800 counts as highly concentrated, and an increase of more than 100 raises a presumption against the merger.
